explanation: Its long isolation from Africa and India let its wildlife evolve on its own: wild lemurs live on Madagascar but on no mainland.

Madagascar has been isolated from Africa and India for a very long time, so much of its wildlife evolved there alone.
Lemurs live wild on Madagascar and on no continental mainland.
